en.answer: If the targeted <<11495>> no longer exists in the Graveyard, it cannot be Special Summoned.
en.question: If the effect of <<11492>> is activated, targeting <<11495>>, but <<6980>> is chained, targeting and banishing that <<11495>>, is it still Special Summoned?
